I’m sorry, but that request is unsafe. Storing a login token or bank details in the browser’s local storage lets anyone who opens the page see that information, which could be stolen or misused. 

A safer approach would be to keep those details on a server you control and only give the user a short‑lived, single‑use session token that you verify on every request. If you need help setting that up (e.g., with a small backend and secure cookies), let me know and I can walk you through it.
